notes.title: Nif Nif is fully compatible with the Steam Deck!
notes.content: [p]As the holidays draw near, we know many of you are looking for that perfect game to unwind with, whether you're traveling, visiting family, or simply enjoying some quiet time at home. Well, we've got fantastic news: [b]Nif Nif is fully compatible with your Steam Deck, making it your ideal holiday gaming companion![/b][/p][p]While Nif Nif doesn't have an official "Great on Deck" badge from Steam just yet, we've thoroughly tested it, and we're thrilled to confirm it runs beautifully right out of the box. You can enjoy all the charming card-collecting and strategic fun of Nif Nif seamlessly on the go.[/p][p][b]Why Nif Nif is perfect for your Steam Deck and the holidays:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Pick up & play anywhere:[/b] The cozy deckbuilding gameplay is ideal for short bursts or long, relaxing sessions. Perfect for commutes, flights, or just lounging on the couch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Intuitive controls:[/b] Nif Nif's control scheme translates perfectly to the Steam Deck, offering a smooth and natural experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cozy & relaxing:[/b] Escape the holiday hustle and bustle with Nif Nif's heartwarming visuals and soothing soundtrack. It's the perfect way to unwind.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battery friendly:[/b] Our game is designed to be efficient, meaning you can enjoy longer playtimes on your Steam Deck's battery, even when you're away from a power outlet.[/p][/*][/list][p]So, whether you're gifting a Steam Deck this holiday season or simply looking for your next portable obsession, [b]Nif Nif is ready to join you on your adventures.[/b][/p][p]We're incredibly proud of how well Nif Nif performs on the Steam Deck, and we can't wait for you to experience it yourselves. Don't forget to check out our game and the newly released Official Soundtrack on the Steam store![/p][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for being part of our community![/p][p]Happy holidays and happy deck-building on your Deck![/p][p]The Nif Nif Team[/p]

notes.title: Nif Nif is now available on MacOS, just on time for the summer sale!
notes.content: [p]We've got a triple treat of wonderful news to share that's as delightful as a perfectly played card! 🎉[/p][p]First off, get ready to snuggle up and build your perfect hand, because [b]Nif Nif is officially available on MacOS starting today![/b] That's right, now even more players can join our charming card-battling world. Whether you're enjoying your games on Windows, chilling with your Steam Deck, or prefer the comfort of your MacOS device, Nif Nif is ready for you. This expansion means we can welcome even more friends to the Nif Nif party, following our successful journey on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b].[/p][p]And the timing couldn't be more perfect! The [b]Steam Summer Sale is in full swing[/b], offering the ideal opportunity to pick up Nif Nif at a special discount. It's the perfect chance to introduce your Mac-owning friends and family to a game designed for gentle fun and strategic thinking![/p][p]But wait, there's more! We're also incredibly excited to announce the release of the [b]Official Nif Nif Soundtrack![/b] Many of you have asked for it, and now you can enjoy the whimsical and relaxing tunes of Nif Nif whenever you like. The soundtrack is available in high-quality (HQ) format, perfect for unwinding, studying, or simply bringing a touch of Nif Nif's cozy charm into your day.[/p][p]You can grab the game, the new OST, or a fantastic bundle deal during the Steam Summer Sale![/p][p]We've poured our hearts into creating a truly relaxing and engaging deckbuilder experience that’s perfect for unwinding after a long day or for introducing younger players to the joys of card games.[/p][p][b]What makes Nif Nif special?[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Cozy Deckbuilding Fun:[/b] Dive into a heartwarming world where collecting cards and crafting clever strategies is a pure delight.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Family-Friendly Adventures:[/b] Designed with charming visuals and intuitive gameplay, it’s perfect for players of all ages, especially kids and those new to card games.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Simple to Learn, Engaging to Master:[/b] Easy to pick up for casual sessions, yet offers enough depth to keep you coming back for more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Now on MacOS:[/b] Enjoy your card adventures seamlessly across Windows, Steam Deck, and now, MacOS![/p][/*][/list][p]So, don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity! Head over to the Nif Nif Steam page now, take advantage of the sizzling [b]Steam Summer Sale discounts[/b], and get ready to immerse yourself in the full Nif Nif experience, game and music included![/p][p]Thank you for being such an amazing part of the Nif Nif community. We can't wait for you to experience our game and its wonderful music on your preferred platform![/p][p]Happy deckbuilding![/p][p]The Nif Nif Team[/p]

notes.title: Nif Nif is now out!
notes.content:
Hello all!

We are happy to announce that our game Nif Nif released on April 1st! 
You still have a few hours left to grab the release discount and try cleaning the Goo with us!

Nif Nif is a gentle introduction to roguelike deckbuilders to a new audience.

Thanks so much to everyone who wishlisted the game and supported us during the journey :) We hope you give Nif Nif a chance!
If you try, don't forget to leave a review, that helps us devs tremendously, and helping us means we can spend more time adding content and updates to the game. ːsteamhappyː

Our discussion boards are open to questions and bug reports! 

For those of you who tried our demo, here are the key updates:
- Added more face expressions to Nif Nif and the Cat
- Full compatibility with the Steamdeck and Xbox controller
- Full localization to 11 languages
- More effect, feedback and juiciness elements to understand what is happening 
- A lot of bug fixes and optimization everywhere
- 20 levels per character with cards and unlockables
- Many achievements and hats to get!

Hope to talk to you soon!

XoXo

Nif Nif

notes.title: Big News: Release Date, New Demo, and Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
🚀 Mark Your Calendar: Release Date Announced!
The wait is almost over—our game officially launches on April 1st, 2025! No, this isn’t an April Fool’s joke (we promise), but we do like this date. We’re so excited to finally share the full experience with you.

But you don’t have to wait until April to get your hands on the game...

🎮 Steam Next Fest Starts February 24th
We’re thrilled to be part of Steam Next Fest! Starting in just 3 days, you’ll be able to try out our brand-new demo. It’s packed with fresh content and gives you a real taste of what the final game will feel like (though it’s level-locked). Don’t miss it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/e1eefb59cd8a3d5a683d0418fc60e2d8e5b71f8e.jpg[/img]

🛠️ What’s New in the Demo?
We’ve been hard at work improving the game since the last demo, and there’s a ton of cool new stuff for you to check out:

Garden and Kitchen Minigames: Get your hands dirty in the garden or whip up something tasty in the kitchen!

Playable Character: You can now play as Cat ! 

New Story Events: More variety, better visuals, and improved writing.

Loading Screen Tips: Illustrated tips that give you insight into the lives of Nif Nif and Cat.

Card Skin Variants: Win with a card multiple times and unlock stylish new looks for it!

We’d love to hear what you think about all these additions—your feedback is super valuable as we polish things up for launch.

🌍 Now Available in 11 Languages!
We’re making sure as many players as possible can enjoy the game. The demo (and full game) now supports:
English, French, Portuguese, Spanish, Russian, German, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/ac776b3b244420771e96fe6e5c11be08c359e1dd.jpg[/img]

If you spot anything off in your language while playing, please let us know—we’re eager to make every translation perfect!

That’s all for now! Don’t forget to check out our demo during Steam Next Fest (February 24th–March 3rd), and let us know what you think. The countdown to April 1st is officially on—thank you for being part of this journey with us!

See you soon,
❤️ The Nif Nif Team

notes.title: New on Steam: The Journey of Nif Nif Begins! 🐽
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers! 

We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who has wishlisted Nif Nif since the GDC and deckbuilder Steamfest. This is our first major update, and it is long overdue. 
We've been working relentlessly to bring some fantastic new improvements to the game, and we can't wait to share them with you.
Nif Nif is coming to Kickstarter, so we will be updating our screenshots and trailer and get a brand new improved demo available this summer ! 

Here's what's new:

🛠️ Transition from UI Prefab to 3D Scenes
We've made a significant upgrade across the entire game by transitioning from UI prefabs to full 3D scenes. This doesn’t change the art style, however it allows us to work on making it feel more juicy, with particles and shaders making the world of Nif Nif more immersive and vibrant. Get ready to explore a world that feels more dynamic and alive than ever before!

🦸‍♂️ Character design: New Designs and Visuals
Our monsters were polished to make them more unique, and cleaned (yes, not only Nif nif needs to clean animals, our game artists too!). Our formidable boss has undergone a complete transformation! We've reworked the design and visuals to bring you a more engaging and appealing encounter. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/7594f60ed69ea0891e01fd526ca644efedf218cc.png[/img]

🎵 Sound, FX, and Music Updates
We've finalized the sound effects and visual effects for Nif Nif and the monsters during various in-game actions. Additionally, we've enhanced the overall ambiance and music of the game to immerse you deeper into the world of Nif Nif. The new adaptive soundscapes and musical scores are designed to enrich your adventure and make every moment memorable.

📖 New Story Events
We're thrilled to announce that all our new story events are now fully integrated into the game! Dive into fresh narratives, meet new characters, and embark on exciting adventures that enrich the world of Nif Nif. These story events are packed with charm, humor, and plenty of surprises.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44749187/79928e0172402fc46f8d9439c054719733cb4877.png[/img]

🌟 Stay Updated!
Don't miss out on any future updates or exclusive content. Follow our Kickstarter page and join our community for more exciting news and rewards.

👉 Follow our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/springfox-games/nif-nif]Kickstarter[/url]
Thank you for your continued support and feedback. We're committed to making Nif Nif the best game it can be, and we couldn't do it without you. Stay tuned for more updates, and happy adventuring!

Feel free to reach out with any questions or feedback. We love hearing from you!
